# Keep version-only release stamps from selecting all 18 Engine E2E shards

## Context

The v14 cut PR #22118 ran all 18 Engine E2E shards. On head `48949c3a42` the [hosted classifier](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45284144875/job/138076163696) gave two reasons: `package-lock.json: unmapped` and `src/DefaultConfig.mjs: foundation`.

## The Problem

The lockfile changed only its two root version fields. DefaultConfig changed only `version` and its matching `@default` value. Treating those as dependency or foundational behavior changes consumed the full matrix on a release with a time-sensitive merge. The same PR had real Portal changes that warrant selected coverage.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `classify-test-scope.yml` describes PR selection as “select only the e2e specs the change can reach”. The workflow already compares package content at both refs. `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` then chooses affected specs, expanding to full coverage for admitted foundation or unmapped files. On the v14 head, passing just `labels.json`, `releases.json` and `FooterContainer.mjs` from the Portal to the existing selector selected 29 specs across four shards.

## The Fix

Recognize the two proven release-stamp deltas in the changed-file comparison. Pass every other affected file through the normal selector. Use the actual diff on both refs so any branch can exercise this behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Replay the v14 file changes in the classifier tests. The two mechanical stamps do not force a full matrix. The affected Portal specs still run, and the required `e2e-engine` context reports the result.
- [ ] A real dependency or integrity change, an edit to another DefaultConfig setting, and an unreadable base each retain full coverage. Mixed diffs retain the strongest applicable coverage.
- [ ] The classifier explains its decision on each file in the CI log. Unit and release-build coverage continue to run under their existing rules.

## Out of Scope

Shard sizing, relaxing required branch checks, or exempting all release branches. #20329 established path admission; #22115 sized the full tier. This issue concerns the content comparison before selection.
